**Fill in the Blank:**

Ghoomar was listed among top local dances globally in ____ year.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2013**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Ghoomar, a traditional folk dance of Rajasthan, was recognized globally and listed among the top local dances in the year **2013**.
 
• This dance form is primarily performed by women and is associated with the heritage of the Bhil tribe, later adopted by the Rajput community.
 
• Ghoomar is characterized by its graceful circular movements and vibrant attire, symbolizing the cultural richness of Rajasthan.
 
• The dance is performed on auspicious occasions such as weddings, festivals, and religious ceremonies.
 
• UNESCO has acknowledged Ghoomar as an integral part of India's intangible cultural heritage, increasing its international recognition.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: 2010**

 
 
• In 2010, cultural initiatives in India were focused on promoting and preserving traditional art forms, but Ghoomar had not yet been globally recognized in that year.
 
• However, this year saw the rise of several Indian art forms gaining attention at national festivals and events.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: 2015**
 
 
• In 2015, the Ministry of Culture in India emphasized the promotion of traditional dances, but Ghoomar had already gained global recognition by then.
 
• It was also a year when UNESCO added more elements of Indian heritage to its lists of intangible cultural heritage, though Ghoomar's recognition had occurred earlier.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: 2018**
 
 
• By 2018, Ghoomar had already been internationally recognized and popularized further through films such as "Padmaavat," where it was prominently featured.
 
• This year primarily saw a surge in the global appeal of Indian cultural elements, but Ghoomar's recognition as a top local dance had occurred much earlier.
 
 
 
• **Main Theme: Ghoomar Dance**
 
 
• Ghoomar is a Rajasthani folk dance that reflects the culture, traditions, and vibrancy of Rajasthan.
 
• It is performed by women wearing traditional ghagra-choli and is known for its intricate footwork and elegant swirling movements.
 
• The dance is often accompanied by traditional Rajasthani music, enhancing its charm and appeal.
 
• Ghoomar has become a symbol of India's rich cultural diversity and is celebrated both nationally and internationally.
